integrity: Analytic proof with exact radial beta moments and pairwise spectral factorizations; finite rational computations are corroborating evidence, not an infinite proof. Independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: First nonconstant projective Laplace eigenspace only; all d >= 3; continuous invariant cap restriction. No claim about larger bands, discrete sampling or historical priority.
title: Two sharp cap-spectral transitions on quaternionic projective space
